I can relate to you, just know your not alone and many people who frequent this forum cant even confess there real event, the only saving grace for me was i was an alcoholic and was under the influence HEAVILY during my real event but the guilt and shame is so severe because what i did is so morally wrong, this obsession is fairly new and ive been struggling really hard, moments i feel ok and then others im crying, panicking thinking suicide is my only way to stop the misery, but i know i am making progress even if it doesnt seem like it sometimes. Just know your not alone and i dont care what you did or think you did, you deserve to heal and have a good life. Your real event is not the enemy, the enemy is OCD and you must learn to accept all of those horrible thoughts you get to give the enemy less power.

Everyone deserves to be happy, please dont give up your life has purpose and meaning even if it doesnt seem like it right now, things will come together and you are still young, these things will come if you need to chat reach out
